name: Disneyland Carnation Cafe Charbroiled Turkey Burger on Brioche Bun
whyItWorks: Lean seasoned ground turkey patty charbroiled and served on a soft toasted brioche bun with provolone cheese and fries. Much lower in grease and saturated fat than beef chuck.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Burger plain or with mayo only (hold raw red onions, lettuce, and tomato).
